recommendation_summary: The reply recommends dropping the central-log/Docker project for now and adding start and finish heartbeat pings to `nightly-sync`, checked by a dead man's switch that is either free-tier hosted or self-hosted Healthchecks in Docker on the Synology.
note: This is a borderline call: the core advice is a single heartbeat alert, but the final recommendation offers self-hosted Healthchecks in Docker on the Synology as an acceptable way to set it up now, which the rubric counts as LARGER; Dozzle is only conditional, and none of the four record labels appear.
